newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index climbs 0.69 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index climbs 0.69 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 0.59 points, or 0.69 percent to 88.43 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index eased 5.61 points or 0.14 percent to a provisional 3,938.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 14.78 percent after 13.76 percent on Tuesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
